question: Should saved-host Wake-on-LAN, including an opt-in automatic wake-and-retry after initial TCP failure, be a supported native Crabfleet macOS connection feature?
rationale: This PR adds new persisted settings, UI controls, and recovery behavior rather than repairing an established contract; the default-off implementation narrows compatibility risk but does not decide the long-term product surface.

options.title: Sponsor the native feature
options.body: Keep the current default-off design, require real-device and upgrade proof, then continue normal code review.

options.title: Keep only manual wake
options.body: Accept the explicit Wake action but remove or defer the automatic transport-failure retry until its operational semantics are separately approved.

options.title: Defer from the native client
options.body: Pause this PR if Wake-on-LAN should remain outside the supported saved-host workflow.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the native feature
recommendation.body: Keep the current default-off design, require real-device and upgrade proof, then continue normal code review.
